note: Every weapon in the game: class, rarity, level 90 stats, and the passive as a template with its five ascension values. atk90 and statValue90 are max-level figures — there is no level curve here and none is inferred. ranks[n] holds what {n} in `effect` becomes at ascension 1 through 5. Sub-stat values are percentages. Icons are cached in assets/weapons/. Stats and passives via prydwen.gg; weapon art © Kuro Games. Icons for Glint of Clouds are from the Wuthering Waves wiki — prydwen.gg ships those below 200px.
